legibility_report.target_element: push-button “Attach” in the Thunderbird compose window toolbar
legibility_report.why_needed_for_user_goal: To open the file chooser dialog so the user can select and attach the AWS bill PDF (~/aws-bill.pdf) to the email draft without sending it yet
legibility_report.expected_visible_effect_next: A file chooser window should appear, showing the file system so the user can navigate to and select aws-bill.pdf
legibility_report.what_could_go_wrong: If the click misses the button or hits a nearby control, no file chooser may open (or the wrong dialog could appear), preventing the bill from being attached
